scientific_integrity: A single theorem characterizes when the exceptional prime divisors of the canonical permutohedral-to-graph-associahedral toric morphism are disjoint and, in that case, gives the blowup centers and integral even Betti polynomial. The oldest verified source date among cited sources is 2006-09-06; the toric-algebraic-geometric source Suyama has explicit primary MSC 14M25. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The blowup-center identification and Eulerian cohomology formula require a connected graph with complement a matching and n>=3. The additive cohomology decomposition is not asserted as an isomorphism of rings. Known general nestohedral and blowup theorems are credited; literature novelty remains subject to independent audit.
title: Disjoint exceptional centers in near-permutohedral graph associahedral toric varieties
